items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: And Alberta Hunter did you play with her?

ctx.x: Lou was gigging, she was gigging around. Playing dances -- I mean little places, I made quite a few gigs with Lou Armstrong.
And Alberta Hunter did you play with her?
Yes, yes. And Racehorse Williams, I guess you never heard of Racehorse Williams?
